title: InterruptPayload
description: Client projection of the JSON-serializable value passed to LangGraph interrupt(). Returned on RunResult / RuntimeState. Resume via ResumeRun API → Command(resume=...) with the same thread_id. See 16-api-surface-interrupt-resume.md.

interrupt_id.description: Stable id for the open interrupt (from LangGraph interrupt id when available, else platform-assigned)

raw.description: Optional original interrupt value if richer than this DTO
